annotations.meaning: Expectation, observation, status, and validity declarations are independent axes; counts can overlap.

annotation_cohorts.interpretation: Within-file observed annotation populations only; contrasts do not establish representativeness, missingness mechanisms, or deployment shift.

multilabel.interpretation: Metrics describe supplied assignments. All-zero complete vectors are valid. Unusual combinations and low cardinality are not label errors.

repeated_inputs.interpretation: Observed disagreements do not establish incorrect labels; complementary partial annotations are compatible. Metadata differences are separate evidence.

parsing.inference_caution: NA-like tokens may become missing; numeric-looking codes may lose leading zeros. No source values were rewritten.

parsing_warnings.interpretation: Inspection stopped at cell_limit; absence of warnings does not establish losslessness.
parsing_warnings.recommendation: Confirm this interpretation matches the source meaning; use an explicit parsing override where appropriate.
parsing_warnings.scope: bounded source inspection; counts are not dataset-wide incidence
